about: The cases that fail TODAY, each with the audit finding(s) whose fix will make it pass (the port-parity audit of 2026-09-29; its plan is pact-gateway/docs/release/port-parity-2026-09-29.md).

js/cases/known.mjs says how js/parity.mjs reads this: a case that fails exactly as `fails` says is excused; a case that fails otherwise, a case that passes with an entry here, and an entry for a case nobody has all fail the run; a port that threw is never excused. So this list can only shrink.
The stage that fixes a finding deletes the entries its fix closes (the run names each one). The last stage deletes this file and its mechanism.

`fails` is how the case fails, as js/parity.mjs names it: `differ` (the two ports answer differently), `<port> off the contract` (an answer contract/contract.json does not allow), `<port> not as expected` (an answer other than the one the spec or CONTRACT §0 fixes for it; a case that misses it is not compared besides).
S1-<n> are divergences the generated cases found that the audit did not file; `new_findings` says what each is.
